                table Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's timezone, derived on read as the IANA name for the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region
                carries no entry in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read - 'EMAIL' when an
                email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived on read from birthDate relative to the

                or over. Present only when a birthDate has been supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'

              title: Owner segment

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        errors:
          title: Errors
          description: Names of the request fields that failed validation.
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          example:
            - city
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - errors
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When supplied it is used to compose the owner's salutation.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a flat address line; when structured address fields are
            supplied ('addressLine1'), they are preferred. On a response this carries the
            composed address (the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Optional;
            when supplied (non-blank) the structured fields are preferred over the flat
            'address' input. Normalized like the flat address (trimmed, inner whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized like addressLine1 and, when present,
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's postcode. Optional; when present it must be a 4-digit value
            and, when the city has a known region (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
            Brisbane -> QLD), must fall within that region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized
            to E.164 form; a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. Spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when
            omitted it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional on create; when present it is used to
            derive the owner's ageBand relative to the registrationDate. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true on create, bypasses the household duplicate block so this owner
            can be registered even though another owner already shares its household (the same last
            name, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace, and postcode). Such an
            owner is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible
            duplicate. Otherwise a create sharing an existing household is rejected with 409
            Conflict. Request-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical relative URL of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, derived on read as the title and last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when no title
                was supplied.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                on read; the raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is
                the region code derived from the postcode, FY the two-digit fiscal year (starting
                1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 the first 8 upper-case
                hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with lastName,
                and CHK a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
                On the rare collision with an existing member id, '-<n>' is appended with the
                smallest n of 2 or more that makes it unique.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household, i.e.
                owners with the same last name (compared case-insensitively with collapsed
                whitespace) and postcode. It is the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                'normalizedLastName|postcode', so owners sharing a last name and postcode share it
                automatically, regardless of registration order.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key used for duplicate detection, the lower-case hex
                SHA-256 of 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email segment is
                empty when no email is present). A create is rejected with 409 Conflict only when a
                new owner's identityKey equals a non-deleted existing owner's; because the telephone
                is part of the key, two owners with the same last name and postcode but different
                telephones have different keys and are both allowed (the later one flagged a possible
                duplicate rather than rejected).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '3a1f...c9'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing
                the same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 0
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, derived on read from the (business-day-adjusted)
                registrationDate as 'FY<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year
                (starting 1 July) that contains the registration date - a date in July-December
                belongs to the fiscal year ending the following calendar year (e.g. a date of
                2026-09-05 yields 'FY27').

              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY27'

              description: The owner's membership points, derived on read. Starts at 0, adds 2 when
                an email is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0, adds 2 for a household of 3 or
                more, and adds 3 for tenure over one fiscal year (elapsed fiscal years from
                registrationDate to today).

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:

              description: The owner's numeric membership level, derived on read from
                membershipPoints - level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or
                more.

              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 2

                leading REGION segment of the memberId ('<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'). This is

                table Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').

              example: 'NSW'
            timezone:

                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region
                carries no entry in the table.

                email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.

              type: string

## Change

The spec required a derived `riskFlag` on an owner that is `true` when **any** of three risk signals hold. I implemented it by reusing the rules that already own each concept rather than re-deriving them:

**1. OpenAPI schema** (`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`) — added a `riskFlag` read-only boolean to the `Owner` schema (DTOs are generated from this spec at build time), documenting the three conditions.

**2. Controller** (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`):
- Wired `ownerDto.setRiskFlag(isRiskFlag(owner))` into `buildOwnerDto`, alongside the existing `bulkSignupWarning`/`capacityWarning` derived flags.
- `isRiskFlag(owner)` returns true when:
  - **possible duplicate** — `owner.getPossibleDuplicate()` is true (the existing possible-duplicate rule);
  - **disposable-adjacent email** — new `isDisposableAdjacentDomain(...)` helper;
  - **city over soft capacity** — reuses the existing `isCapacityWarning(owner)` (city holds ≥40 and <50 other owners, i.e. at/over the soft threshold, one band below the hard cap that rejects creation).
- `isDisposableAdjacentDomain` is a *softer* signal than the existing exact `DISPOSABLE_EMAIL_DOMAINS` blocklist (which rejects creates with 400): it matches when the email's domain **is**, **is a subdomain of**, or **shares its second-level label** with a known disposable domain — so `mailinator.com`, `x.mailinator.com`, and `mailinator.net` all flag, while unrelated domains don't. This catches disposable-adjacent addresses that slip past the hard gate (e.g. via `updateOwner`, which doesn't run the disposable check).
